textures.name: Melody + nocturne bass
textures.function: Singing RH over wide LH arpeggio

textures.name: Melody + chorale
textures.function: RH melody above block chords (both hands)

textures.name: Melody + countermelody
textures.function: Two independent RH voices (soprano + tenor)

textures.name: Continuous figuration
textures.function: One hand plays unbroken pattern; other hand has melody embedded

textures.name: Octave melody + tremolo
textures.function: RH in octaves, LH in tremolo or rapid arpeggios

textures.name: Bare unison/octave
textures.function: Both hands in octaves, no harmony

textures.function: Delicate RH passagework over sustained LH pedal tone

textures.function: Rapid LH figuration + massive RH chords

textures.name: Melody + accompaniment
textures.function: One instrument sings, others provide rhythmic/harmonic support

textures.name: Tremolo atmosphere

textures.name: Chorale
textures.function: Block chords in all parts; homophonic; hymn-like

textures.name: Dialogue
textures.function: Melody passes phrase-by-phrase between instruments or instrument groups

textures.name: Divine moment
textures.function: High strings only (pp/ppp); low instruments tacet; one sustained chord

textures.name: Unison/octave tutti
textures.function: All instruments on the same melody in unison or octaves

textures.name: 2 Hn, 2 Tpt, 3 Tbn (late works)

textures.name: 2 drums (tonic + dominant)
textures.function: Rhythmic punctuation; not prominent

textures.name: Vln I, Vln II, Vla, Vc, Cb
textures.function: Core texture; violins often doubled in octaves or thirds

textures.name: 2 Fl, 2 Ob, 2 Cl, 2 Bsn

textures.name: March/chorale

textures.name: Tremolo/tremolando

textures.name: 2 Fl, 2 Ob, 2 Cl, 2 Bsn

textures.name: Timpani only
textures.function: Structural accents, pedal point reinforcement

textures.name: Tutti warmth

textures.name: 2 Fl, 2 Ob, 2 Cl (Bb), 2 Bsn

textures.name: Harp (1-2), Organ (sacred works)

Vln solo + pizz strings; triangle, cymbal
